# Vocabulary graphs of the LOV dump that the Docker image may ship.
# Generated by scripts/build_lov_catalog.py; do not edit by hand.
# Dump: https://web.archive.org/web/20251218081818id_/https://lov.linkeddata.es/lov.nq.gz (snapshot 2025-12-18, sha256 7b5522b4f86d642d7e48df289f3d3330898e9aa021cc4d4ef0ad38f0f039c233)
# A graph is listed only when its licence allows redistributing a copy:
# the licence the vocabulary declares in its own graph or, where the
# graph names none, the terms its publisher states elsewhere (see the
# script's PUBLISHER_TERMS), and when LOV's copy can be shipped under it
# (see WITHHELD).  Each graph is LOV's N-Quads serialization as found in
# LOV's dump, shipped unchanged; where LOV's copy has mis-decoded text
# (UTF-8 read as Latin-1 or Windows-1252) the notice column says so.
# Columns (tab-separated): graph IRI, LOV prefix, licence, source of the
# licence ("graph", or the URL of the publisher's terms), and the notice
# the licence requires on copies (empty when it asks only for the usual
# attribution).  The catalogue entry's license_uris gives each licence's
# URI.
